what: evidence that the held face has been mounted in a real, non-headless window -- not only in the headless renderer tools/shoot.mjs and tools/browser-mount-smoke.mjs drive
why: req/02 W15 clause 3: a face must carry proof of having mounted in a real window a person could look at. tools/browser-mount-smoke.mjs and tools/real-window-smoke.mjs in this same faces/held/tools/ directory were written from zero for this face, following the same shape faces/ledger and faces/notice already established (fixture served over http + shell/tools/real_window.ps1, the shell's own real-window instrument, reused rather than duplicated) -- not by opening either face's own tool files.
how: tools/real-window-smoke.mjs starts a static file server rooted at the repo (answering /s-common/tokens.css from the one stylesheet of record), then shells out to shell/tools/real_window.ps1 with the fixture's URL. That script opens Chrome in app mode at 1440x900, waits, reads the window's own title back through the Win32 window list, and screenshots the on-screen window rectangle. This face's mount fixture (fixtures/browser-mount-entry.mjs + fixtures/browser-mount.html) imports index.mjs directly and calls mount(host, stubPort, []) against two held candidates spelled out inline in the fixture, and writes the element/row counts into document.title so the numbers below are the numbers the page itself computed, not typed by hand.
environment_gap: on this machine, parts/tools/token-source.mjs resolves the stylesheet of record to a path in the retired reference tree (ui_proto's tokens.css), which does not exist here (confirmed absent on C:, D: and E: -- searched at capture time). This is a pre-existing gap unrelated to this face: the same three parts/test/tokens*.test.mjs failures this repo already carries (461 tests run tree-wide, 458 pass, 3 fail, all three in that suite, none touching faces/held) come from the identical missing path. Every capture below -- fixtures/shots/*.png, fixtures/shots/browser-mount-smoke.png, and both real_window_*.png -- was taken with tokens.css unreachable, so the stylesheet-of-record's actual colour is not evidenced in this record; what is evidenced is the structural reading (no overlap, no double-draw, no oversize/filled glyph, no unsealed row, correct fail-closed wording), which does not depend on the stylesheet resolving. Regenerating a colour-faithful capture needs either the reference tree restored at that path on the capturing machine, or parts/tools/token-source.mjs repointed at a location this repo carries -- both out of this lane's scope (shared infra, not faces/held).
